svg.title: Lourdu Raju
svg.desc: Lourdu Raju, machine learning engineer at Sujanix in Bengaluru. An ink ensō with the kanji 侍 (samurai) and an LR seal; a vertical inscription 七転八起 (fall seven times, rise eight); a terminal line types: production computer vision; tensorrt, triton, gpu inference; 40M readings, 79% to 91%; measure first, ship second.
svg.text: ml engineer @ sujanix · bengaluru · open to ml roles
